# orion placement

Places a card appears on the canvas (spike for #122)

```sh
orion placement <command> [options]
```

## orion placement add

Show a card in one more group. Every copy edits the same card, and links join the card

```sh
orion placement add [id] [options]
```

| Argument          | Description                                                                               |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[id]`            | Item or group id, or a selector such as label:"Extract slider", ref:jira:ABC-12, or pr:86 |
| `--group <value>` | Group to show the card in; the top level when absent                                      |
| `--json`          | Print JSON                                                                                |

## orion placement remove

Take one copy of a card off the canvas and keep the card. Use node remove to delete the card everywhere

```sh
orion placement remove [id] [options]
```

| Argument | Description                                                            |
| -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[id]`   | Placement id from placement list, or the card's id for its first place |
| `--json` | Print JSON                                                             |

## orion placement list

List every place a card appears, its own first

```sh
orion placement list [id] [options]
```

| Argument | Description                                                                               |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `[id]`   | Item or group id, or a selector such as label:"Extract slider", ref:jira:ABC-12, or pr:86 |
| `--json` | Print JSON                                                                                |
